title: Fourteen Winters and One Short Line
subtitle: 个人成长 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 个人成长（做人与做事·正确的人生态度）
meta: 主题语境：个人成长（做人与做事·正确的人生态度）　|　核心词汇：effort　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 effort 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 my teacher ① made an effort that no parent in the village would have praised, and he said the making was the whole of the winter. The ② effort, meaning the attempt and not the result, ran fourteen winters and stayed unnamed in the book; an effort, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left unpraised.

Every ③ effort in that village had the same short line at the end of it, and the ④ effort at the end, meaning the one they kept for the slowest pupils and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An effort, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to praise; my teacher said the praising is the part that fills fourteen winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the effort was the whole of the story, meaning the trouble and not the attempt. The ⑥ effort, meaning the trouble and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody speaks of and nobody measures; effort, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both an attempt and a trouble. He said the trouble is the part they remember.

By 1957 the ⑦ effort had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short line. The ⑧ effort of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in January, was one village and fourteen winters of praising; effort, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to praise. She said the praising was never mentioned.

The ⑨ effort I remember is the one named in the report, which ended in 1969 and is still described as the quietest in the village. An ⑩ effort, my mother said in 1971, is the only one that improves by being praised; every effort, she said, is a trouble that has agreed to look like an attempt. She said the trouble was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 努力；尽力（指那个村子里付出过的那一次）
B. n. 努力；尽力（指那份努力本身，与成果相对）
C. 固定搭配：make an effort 作出一次努力
D. n. 努力；尽力（指留给最慢的学生们的那一次）
E. n. 努力；尽力（抽象总称，指一个村子的用功之事）
F. n. 努力；尽力（指评语上写到、被列名的那一次）
G. n. 费力的事；辛苦（指故事里人人都谈起却无人计量的那样东西）
H. n. 辛苦（抽象总称，指人人都谈起却无人计量的那种东西）

items.q: made an effort that no parent in the village would have praised
The effort, meaning the attempt and not the result
the effort was the whole of the story
the effort had become a line in a report
The effort of the whole thing
An effort, my mother said in 1971

answers.why: make an effort 意为“作出一次努力”，1948 年老师作出了一次村子里没有一位家长肯称赞的努力。
effort 意为“努力、尽力”，指那份努力本身而不是成果，它经过了十四个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
effort 意为“努力、尽力”，指那个村子里的每一次努力，每一次后头都有同一行短短的评语。
effort 意为“努力、尽力”，指留给最慢的学生们的那一次，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
effort 意为“费力的事、辛苦”，指故事里人人都谈起却无人计量的那样东西，叔叔说这份辛苦就是那个故事的全部。
effort 意为“辛苦”，指人人都谈起却无人计量的那种东西而不是那份努力，是故事里人人都谈起、却无人计量的东西。
effort 意为“努力、尽力”，指评语上写到、被列名的那一次，到 1957 年这次努力成了评语里的一行。
effort 意为“努力、尽力”，老师一月写道，整件事的用功之事是一个村子和十四个冬天的称赞。
effort 意为“努力、尽力”，我记得的是评语上列名的那一次，1969 年结束了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一次。
effort 为抽象总称，母亲 1971 年说，一次努力是唯一会因为被好好称赞而变得更好的东西。
